title.from: Dogfood install as-is in BotSpy after Pudicus ships
title.to: Coordinate LeftBlock adoption with the BotSpy readiness owner

description.from: BotSpy already has a separately installed Pudicus integration. The newly hardened source has not implicitly upgraded it. Pending: review the existing custom policy, interpreter, receipt gate, hook configuration and all active siblings; then adopt the reviewed published GitBouncer build with legacy compatibility and synthetic clean/blocked/error tests. Preserve existing hooks and policy. No rollout has been performed by this task. This issue depends on product publication; it is not complete.
description.to: BotSpy source and readiness are owned by a separate active track. Coordinate with that owner before adopting LeftBlock; do not duplicate their source changes, tracker ownership, or hook work. Verify the existing installed integration, policy, interpreter and receipt gate, then agree the safe upgrade and synthetic clean/sensitive/error evidence against the reviewed package. This LeftBlock-board row records the dependency and handoff only. No BotSpy installation or readiness result is claimed here; its own board remains with its owner.
